outcome: Structural anomalies (ventriculomegaly, micrognathia, amniotic fluid increase, limb movement, club foot, scoliosis)
Neonatal outcomes (health status, psychomotor development, survival/death)
cohort: Two fetuses diagnosed with persistent fetal neck hyperextension prenatally, followed through birth and postnatally.
finding: Persistent fetal neck hyperextension was associated with various structural anomalies and led to highly variable postnatal outcomes, including retarded psychomotor development and death.
mod_finding: Both babies were born by cesarean section, but the study did not present findings related to mode of birth and outcomes.
gest_age: Diagnosis in II and III trimester
